errors.what: Foot path is not the characteristic flat-bottomed Jansen path: foot y rises steadily from -79 to -29 mm over 0-120 deg, then swings up to +100 mm and jumps about 115 mm in x between 150 and 180 deg and again between 180 and 210 deg, so the stride is too large and discontinuous.

Assembly configuration flips around 150-210 deg: the leg triangle and linkage go to a near-vertical, mirrored branch (leg triangle above the pivots) instead of a continuous walking cycle, suggesting wrong assembly branch or wrong link lengths.
